summary: Mega Matrix Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026 disclosing a 1-for-20 share consolidation approved by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on September 1, 2026, with a Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles taking effect September 15, 2026. Terms: 62,492,148 pre-consolidation Class A ordinary shares reduce to approximately 3,124,608 post-consolidation shares; par value rises from USD0.001 to USD0.02; trading on NYSE American under symbol MPU begins post-consolidation-adjusted September 16, 2026; new CUSIP G6005C116. The stated purpose is maintaining the NYSE American listing by raising the per-share trading price. Watch for continued listing compliance and any reverse-split-related volatility or financing overhang.
